counterfactual_missing_items: No raw span documents clinical relevance of the positive patch tests
No raw span documents improvement after allergen avoidance
No raw span documents a specific exposure causing the hand eczema
response.rationale: R3 is supported by classic atopic dermatitis criteria: early childhood onset, personal atopy (asthma/rhinitis), and family atopy. R2 is supported only by patch-test sensitization; without documented relevance or exposure-response, multiple positives in an atopic patient do not establish allergic contact dermatitis as the most likely diagnosis. C1 is a correlated restatement of R3 adding chronicity; its raw span supports duration, not the atopic mechanism, so it is discounted.

rejected.why: Redundant append-only completion of R3; its only raw span ('18 years history of very severe chronic hand eczema') supports chronicity, not atopic dermatitis, and adds no independent discriminating evidence.
